authority: Маркази Исломии Ҷумҳурии Тоҷикистон / Шӯрои уламо (shuroiulamo.tj)
surface: POST https://shuroiulamo.tj/tj/namaz/ntime with fmonth=&fyear=&fday=0 -> the whole requested month as <tr> rows
discovered_via: the inline getNamazTime() handler on https://shuroiulamo.tj/tj/namaz (which the page itself calls with the day/month/year form)
archive_floor: 2014-12 (2014-11 and earlier return the literal string 'no')
archive_ceiling: 2026-11 (2026-12 onward returns 'no' - published only once the month begins)
instant_form_found: YES - the authority's own homepage widget publishes today's five prayer instants for Dushanbe (captures/home-shuroiulamo-tj.html, 11.11.2026: 05:32 / 12:40 / 15:32 / 17:26 / 18:56). Verified equal to the left bound of the same day's window row: data/tj-instants-derived-*.json is the left-bound derivation, valid by that check.
window_stability: recomputed, not a fixed template: 0 of 365 month-days are byte-identical across years, median fajr-start spread 15 min across 2015-2026.
method_change_detected: dhuhr window start 13:00 through 2019-06-30, 12:40 from 2019-07-01 onward (2020-10-01..10-31 transitional at 12:50).
defects: 104 cells printed as 00:00 (sparse publication nulls, e.g. 2019-03-21 fajr, 2023-05-19 dhuhr); isolated outliers 2017-06-23 dhuhr 00:13 and 2023-02-19 dhuhr 12:00.
